notes: Studied itsnotalwin/shutterhaus-site @084a13b (main; live site cross-checked). Refresh, not rebrand: the identity is real and approved (Bodoni Moda/Inter, white editorial, monochrome, 'Portraits worth keeping.'), so execution was raised instead. Five pages, Sessions folded into Index and Contact. Arc motif promoted to structure; museum captions on all plates (the deployed About figure had none). Wall = the studio's committed 30 frames plus the archive's four vistas, making People/Places/Stories literal; plate titles are editorial labels; years n.d. except the 2024 shoot (archive carries no dates). Two gallery modes: scroll-settled plates + keyboard lightbox (arrows/Home/End/Escape, focus trapped+returned, inert background, live announcements). Photos are the studio's own, re-derived monochrome from public/gallery; packages/terms/copy verbatim from config.ts and pricing.json. No phone (owner's 2026-10-03 decision). Form uses the documented email-app fallback; zero third-party requests; fonts self-hosted with OFL. Limits: 404 cannot emit an HTTP status alone; og:image points at the production card. Tested: file:// render, keyboard pass, links, contrast, <=250KB non-photo budget.
